rows.itemTitle: FRANCHISOR ASSISTANCE ADVERTISING COMPUTER SYSTEMS AND TRAINING
rows.summary: Between 2022 and 2026, Item 11 moved from an undeveloped brand fund and a small per-user technology stack to a materially expanded and repriced program: a 2% Brand Fund Fee and $650/month Technology Fee were added, training hours roughly tripled, local advertising moved from a quarterly $5,000/7.5%-of-annual-sales formula to a monthly $3,000/6%-of-monthly-sales formula, and several franchisor obligations and controls were added while others were dropped.

oldEvidence.quote: You, your Operating Principal (if you are an Entity), and any other employees that we designate must attend and satisfactorily complete our franchisee initial training program (“Initial Training”) within 90 days after executing the Franchise Agreement.
We estimate that the typical length of time between signing a Franchise Agreement and beginning to offer to sell Equipment and perform Services for your Franchised Business is approximately 90 days.
We will provide instructors, facilities, and materials for the Initial Training at no cost to you, provided that all of your personnel are trained during the same training session.
Should your Operating Principal fail to complete training to our satisfaction, we may elect to terminate the Franchise Agreement and refund one-half of the Initial Franchise Fee.
TOTALS 21 55 Our office/your location

We reserve the right to charge a reasonable fee for training persons who are repeating the course or replacing a person who did not pass and for subsequent Operating Principals or employees who attend the course.
We or our affiliates may make available to you to purchase from us or our designee on our then-current prices and terms additional Equipment and Vehicles, as well as supplies.
We will help you manage your online advertising campaign, which we highly recommend, but do not require of you. Campaign expenses will be charged to you at our cost.
We are not obligated to conduct any advertising or marketing programs within your Territory.

In connection with the opening of your Franchised Business, you must spend $4,500 to $9,000 for initial launch advertising and promotion in the two weeks prior to opening the Franchised Business and the three months after your Franchised Business opens in accordance with a plan that we must approve.
We require that you expend each quarter no less than $5,000 or the greater of 7.5% of your annual Gross Sales, divided by 4, for local advertising.
We may in the future create a GGF Brand Fund (the “Fund”) into which all Brand Fund Fees will be paid.
All Franchised Businesses will contribute to the Fund a uniform percentage of the Brand Fund Fees.
Because we have not yet established the fund, we do not have financial data relating to the Fund.

Company-owned and affiliate-owned Businesses will contribute to the Fund in the same manner as our Franchised Businesses. If we reduce the Fund contribution rate for Franchised Businesses, we will reduce the contribution rate for company-owned and affiliate-owned Businesses by the same amount.
Upon written request, we will prepare an unaudited statement of contributions and expenditures for the Fund and make it available to you in a manner of our choosing.

If we establish a Franchisee Advisory Council, you must participate in all council-related activities and meetings and must pay any dues related to the administration of the Franchise Advisory Council.

Prior to entering into any lease, you must submit the proposed site lease and any information about the site that we request to us for our approval. We have the right to require your lease to include any provisions that we may reasonably require, which we may specify in the Manuals or otherwise in writing.

We currently do not have any required computer requirements, except that you must own a personal computer with high-speed internet connection to the Internet and must have a dedicated digital business telephone number that is listed in telephone directories that we prescribe.
We require you to use proprietary CRM software called Method, which integrates
with QuickBooks and use our customization provider. This software will be “Cloud” hosted through Right Networks using a virtual private network.
To use the Software, we may require you to sign a software licensing agreement and pay us a monthly licensing fee for the use of the Software (currently about $50 to $75 per month per user).
We will supply you with a Website Management Fee at a cost which is currently $95 per month. This is payable to us. The fee is subject to change upon 30 days advance notice from us to you.
We will host your email, at a cost which is currently $6 per month per user.
You must maintain your computer system at your expense and must replace, upgrade, or update your computer system as we may require periodically, which may not be more than once per year.
If you do not already own a personal computer, we estimate that it may cost you up to $1,000 to purchase the necessary hardware and software.

You must give us unrestricted electronic access (including users IDs and passwords, if necessary) to the above network so we can properly support your franchise business to include QuickBooks and Method.
There are no contractual limitations on our right to access data stored in the cloud or in your computer based on the system we have set up for you to manage your business.

We may amend, modify, or supplement the Manuals at any time, so long as the amendments, modifications, or supplements will, in our good faith opinion, benefit us and our franchisees or will otherwise improve the System.
Currently, the Manuals total 195 pages.
We will furnish you with one copy of, or electronic access to, our Manuals, on loan for as long as your Franchise Agreement or a successor franchise agreement remains in effect.

Opening Assistance. We will advise you as to initial orders of Equipment and supplies and advise you as to establishment of business relationships with approved suppliers. We may, in our sole discretion, provide you with additional assistance in connection with the opening of your Franchised Business.

We will provide you with a template for your initial launch advertising plan. We will review and, in our sole discretion, approve or disapprove your modifications to the initial launch advertising plan template.

newEvidence.quote: You or your Operating Principal, if you are an Entity, must attend and satisfactorily complete our initial training program within 120 days after executing the Franchise Agreement.
We estimate that the typical length of time between signing a Franchise Agreement and beginning to perform Services for your Franchised Business is approximately 120 days.

If you do not offer Services for your Franchised Business within 120 days after signing the Franchise Agreement, we may terminate the Franchise Agreement and we will retain any amounts you paid to us or our affiliates.
Before opening the Franchised Business, you must purchase or lease at least 1 vehicle we have approved and it must be wrapped and outfitted as we specify.

We do not charge for the initial training program for up to 2 attendees, one of which must be you or your Operating Principal (if you are an Entity) and the other who should be a manager or technician. We charge a fee for additional attendees.
If you or your Operating Principal fail to complete training to our satisfaction, we may terminate the Franchise Agreement and retain all amounts you have paid to us and our affiliates.
TOTALS 62 81

We currently charge $500 per day to train persons who are repeating the initial training program or to train a replacement for someone who did not pass the initial training program and for initial training for subsequent Operating Principals or employees who attend the initial training program.

Upon your request and our agreement, we will provide you with on-site extended assistance for on-site advice or training. You must pay for the travel and living expenses of our personnel who provide this assistance and our then-current consulting fee, which is currently $500 per day for each person.

We have no obligation to develop products or services that you will offer to customers, improve or develop your Franchised Business, establish administrative, bookkeeping and inventory control procedures for your use or except as disclosed above, resolve operating problems you encounter.
We or our affiliates may make available to you to purchase from us or our designee on our then-current prices and terms additional equipment, as well as supplies.
Upon your request and payment, make available digital marketing services, including add-on or plug-in tools and paid digital lead generation services.
We have no obligation to conduct any advertising on your behalf or for the Granite Garage Floors franchise system.
You must purchase from our approved suppliers the pre-opening marketing package that we prescribe.
You must spend a minimum of $3,000 per month on local advertising or 6% of your monthly Gross Sales, whichever is greater.
We collect a monthly Brand Fund Fee. The Brand Fund Fee is 2% of your monthly Gross Sales. The Brand Fund Fee is non-refundable and is due at the time your royalty is required to be paid.
Neither we nor any of our affiliates have any obligation to contribute to the Brand Fund for Granite Garage Floors businesses operated by us or our affiliates.
The Brand Fund is not audited but will prepare annual income and expense statements. Income and expense statements will be available to you upon request.
We may, but have no obligation to, loan amounts to the Fund and can determine the repayment obligation of the Fund, including interest rate of the loan and repayment terms, as we see fit.

You must have a personal computer with high-speed internet connection to the Internet, a tablet computer sufficient to operate our field service software and a dedicated digital business telephone number that is listed in telephone directories that we prescribe.
We provide you with our bookkeeping software and four branded email user licenses.
You must obtain, maintain and use in your business the bookkeeping software and field service software we require, along with other software that we may specify from time to time.
The bookkeeping software, which we provide to you, is currently $55 per month.
You must also pay us a Technology Fee. The Technology Fee is currently $650 per month.
The current cost for the branded email licenses is $15 per month per license.
Payment Processing Services. We will provide you with payment processing services that you must use in your Franchised Business.
You must also purchase payment processing services from us. The cost for these services is $35 per month per account plus transaction fees.
You must maintain your computer system at your expense and must replace, upgrade, or update your computer system as we may require periodically.
We estimate that the annual costs to maintain, replace, upgrade or update your computer system will range from $1,000 to $2,000.

We will have independent access to the information that will be generated and stored in your computer systems, including in any accounting or financial systems you may maintain. This data will include financial information, accounting information, customer data, and any other data about your business, with the exception of employment records. There are no contractual limitations on our right to access any of this data.
We will not integrate any third-party software or services to our systems.
We may periodically inspect the operation of your Franchised Business and advise you of its results. We may provide you with a written action plan that you must carry out after each inspection.
Demonstration Kits. We will sell to you Demonstration Kits that you must use in your Franchised Business.
We may amend, modify, or supplement the Manuals at any time.
As of December 31, 2024, the Operations Manual contained 66 pages.
We will make available to you in electronic form our Operations Manual (Franchise Agreement - Section 4.1).

During our fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, Brand Fund amounts were spent as follows: 13.5% on software subscriptions, 9% on websites, 0.3% on print ads, 4% on content creation, 0.2% on digital referrals, 3.5% on pay per click advertising, 1% on television / radio ads, 68.5% on administrative expenses.
Launch Advertising. We will provide you with a template for your initial launch advertising plan.
